method: All scoped files read and hashed. TS/JS parsed with TypeScript, JSON with JSON.parse; SQL requires the separate optional pglast gate (inventory syntaxErrors:null means not parsed here). Indicators are review aids, not proof of bugs or manual line-by-line verification. tsc verifies imports/types; regression suites verify behavior. Archived SQL is inventoried only, never replayed.
